title: Fixes to workforce housing law chapter 2.96
summary: The Housing Advisory Board reviewed proposed changes to chapter 2.96, the residential workforce housing law, including defining area median income and fixing fee waiver references. The meeting adjourned early over a Sunshine Law concern, and all items are to be reposted for a future meeting.
